description: Attorney Owen T. Weaver, a well accomplished municipal attorney, civil litigator, and a proven local leader, is seeking to become the Republican candidate for Connecticut’s 14th State Senate District. Owen will bring his legal experience, local roots, and record of civic involvement to State Senate.
